title: Fence null-stamp captured summaries below a session's admitted paired-read revision
outcome: A captured snapshot from before the session's first mutation cannot roll back session metadata after an admitted newer paired body read, without coupling body reads to the global revision ledger.
acceptance: A captured pre-first-mutation null-stamp summary delivered after a newer admitted paired body response has a fail-first regression with ref, store and render assertions and accepted-instance-reset/excluded-session controls.

An independently concurred per-session revision-floor design preserves global membership and unrelated state while refusing older per-session metadata below the last admitted paired-read revision, including absent or null mutation stamps.
Focused regressions, a full gate and a fresh complete independent read-only review pair pass on the exact input before completion.
